node: AI accelerators, HBM memory, and advanced packaging stack
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the HBM plus advanced-packaging constraint with emphasis on less-obvious second-order beneficiaries. The strongest mapped candidates are OSAT capacity providers and inspection/metrology/test vendors whose tools or services are needed as AI accelerators move to HBM, chiplets, 2.5D/3D integration, hybrid bonding, and higher bump/interconnect density. This is a research universe, not a buy/sell list.
